Chat request with response_format json_schema that validates the output structure

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the temperature in Paris today?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"response_format\":{\"json_schema\":{\"name\":\"weather\",\"schema\":{\"properties\":{\"temp\":{\"type\":\"number\"}},\"required\":[\"temp\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"json_schema\"}}")
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].message.content)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)

asyncio.run(main())
```
